image_description: A close-up, side-profile portrait of a bison's head and shoulder hump. The image focuses on the dense, dark brown shaggy fur, a prominent curved horn with a yellowish base, a visible dark eye, and the massive structure of the forequarters. The background is a soft-focus green field.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large broad head with short curved horns.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is visibly large and broad relative to the frame. One horn is clearly visible, showing a short, thick, upward-curving structure consistent with bison anatomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Beard of long hair on chin and throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is cropped at the neck/jawline; the chin and throat area where the beard would be located are outside the frame or obscured by the angle.
One eye is clearly visible, appearing dark and round, surrounded by fur.
No prominent external ear pinna is visible; the area where the ear would be is covered by the thick shaggy fur, consistent with the 'hidden' description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Massive body with exceptionally tall, heavily built proportions at the withers.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The shoulder hump is extremely prominent and high, indicating the massive build characteristic of a bison.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Shaggy dark brown fur covering forequarters forming prominent shoulder hump.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The texture is distinctly shaggy and woolly, dark brown in color, and forms the characteristic hump shape.
The hindquarters are completely outside the frame of this close-up shot.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Short horns compared to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible horn is thick but relatively short in length compared to the massive volume of the head and shoulder mass.
Legs and hooves are not visible in this head-and-shoulders crop.
The tail is located at the rear of the animal and is not visible in this frame.

artifact_observations.location: Base of the right horn (viewer's right)
artifact_observations.reasoning: The transition between the horn keratin and the fur at the base appears slightly smudged or 'melted,' lacking the sharp distinct boundary typically seen in high-resolution wildlife photography. The texture of the horn base also looks somewhat waxy rather than ridged.
Some individual hairs along the top contour of the head blend into the background blur in a way that suggests digital smoothing rather than optical depth-of-field bokeh, though this is subtle.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific species classification and rule out look-alikes like yak or muskox based on fine-grained features.
To analyze the micro-texture of the fur and the material properties of the horn for signs of AI generation artifacts like plasticity or repetition.
To verify the structural integrity of the connection between the horn and the skull, ensuring no fusion or melting artifacts exist.

Edge definition between subject and background
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the horn's surface texture; real bison horns have distinct ridges near the base. Check if the AI has smoothed this out. Also, verify if the eye has a natural catchlight or if it appears dead/painted.
